narrative: The kingdom of Valdrenn is a mountain realm whose villages depend on a single trade road. After a long winter, travelers speak of strange lights over the northern pass, and the crown has quietly stopped sending patrols there.
rules: Magic exists and is channeled through wands and spoken spells.
Giants live in the high peaks and avoid human settlements.
Every spell costs the caster physical stamina.

places.name: Valdrenn
places.desc: A remote mountain kingdom characterized by steep valleys, fortified settlements and harsh winters. Its economy relies heavily on mining, livestock and trade with neighboring territories. Ancient traditions and royal authority shape everyday life, while isolated communities often develop their own customs.

places.name: Northern Pass
places.desc: A vast mountain passage connecting Valdrenn with the northern territories. Its narrow trails, unstable cliffs and unpredictable weather make it difficult to cross. Scattered watchtowers and abandoned fortifications suggest that it once held considerable strategic importance.

places.name: High Peaks
places.desc: An extensive mountain range dominated by towering summits, glaciers and deep ravines. The region is sparsely inhabited due to its extreme conditions and difficult terrain. Giants are believed to inhabit its highest elevations, where ancient ruins and unexplored caves can also be found.
